diagnosis_explanation: Your thyroid is a gland in your neck. It makes important body chemicals. A goiter is when the thyroid gets larger. Yours is large enough to cause symptoms. This means it is causing problems for you.
medication_rationale:
Synthroid:
This medicine is a thyroid hormone. Your thyroid gland did not make enough for your body. This medicine replaces that hormone. You may feel more energy as your hormone levels get back to normal. Some people feel a bit more restless at first. Call your doctor if you feel shaky, have a fast heartbeat, or cannot sleep.

Vicodin:
This medicine is for pain relief. It helps block pain signals to your brain. You may feel drowsy or sleepy. This is normal while the medicine works. Call your doctor if you have trouble breathing or feel very confused.
escalation_guide:
CALL 911 IMMEDIATELY
These symptoms are life-threatening. Do not drive yourself.
- No symptoms in this tier for your diagnosis.

GO TO THE ER TODAY
Do not wait until tomorrow. Go within a few hours.
- Trouble breathing or swallowing: Your airway may be closing.
- Sudden severe neck pain: You could have bleeding inside.

CALL YOUR DOCTOR
Call during office hours. Do not go to the ER for these.
- Hoarseness or voice change: Your thyroid may press nerves.
- Feeling of fullness in throat: Your goiter may be growing.
- Mild neck pain or pressure: This is common with goiter.
- Questions about Synthroid: Your nurse can help you plan.
- Questions about Vicodin: Your nurse can help you plan.
extraction_warnings: No activity or dietary restrictions extracted.
